Pulse for 11 November 2026

The stories from 11 November 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

AI agents

United blocks AI bookings

United Airlines says unauthorized third-party AI agents may no longer search, book or manage trips on united.com, in its app or through travel agencies.

Long article

Everyday tool

Gemini arrives on CarPlay

Google is bringing the Gemini app to Apple CarPlay. iPhone users can now have hands-free conversations with Gemini Live from the car's display, and the rollout started globally on 11 November 2026.

Long article

AI agents

Databricks' always-on Genie

Databricks has announced a second generation of Genie that works as an always-on, autonomous agent: users give it a goal and boundaries, and it keeps the work moving in the background. The new mode is coming soon to preview.

Everyday tool

Gemini answers yes or no

Google has launched the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint that scores yes/no, multiple-choice and rubric questions instead of generating text, powered by a model called Gemini Decision 1.

Long article

New model

AlphaGenome 2 reads cells

Google DeepMind has released AlphaGenome 2, a model that predicts how DNA variants affect gene activity in specific human cell types rather than whole tissues.

Everyday tool

Adobe's agent in more apps

At Adobe MAX, Adobe brought its Creative Agent to Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects and Frame.io, and previewed local MCP integrations that let third-party agents work in Creative Cloud apps.

Everyday tool

Claude now builds sheets

Anthropic is launching Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets in beta, and its dashboard product becomes generally available as Claude Data. All three are included in every paid plan.

Everyday tool

DeepL translates your tone

DeepL has unveiled Aure, a new voice model for its real-time translator DeepL Voice. It is meant to carry changes in tone, emotion, emphasis and pace into the translated speech as they happen.

AI agents

AI checks Signal's code

Google DeepMind says AI agents have mathematically proved key security properties of the compiled code behind the Signal protocol, using a new framework called AlphaProof Code.
